layout.body:
UNIVERSITY HEALTH AND WELLNESS CONFERENCE
Join us on September 20 at Bergsen University for an inspiring day
dedicated to your health and wellbeing!
Why attend?
- Learn practical tips for boosting your energy and increasing your mental focus for more effective studying.
- Chat with wellness professionals who specialize in student health.
- Access free resources to support your mental and physical well-being.
Schedule Highlights:
9:00 AM–10:00 AM: Registration and Coffee: Meet speakers and fellow students.
10:00 AM–11:30 AM: Keynote: Dr. Aisha Patel on “The Future of Student Healthcare”
11:30 AM–12:30 PM: Panel: “Mental Health in the Classroom” with David Chen, Sofia Martinez, and Dr. Priya Nair
12:30 PM–1:00 PM: Lunch
1:00 PM–2:00 PM: Panel: “Balancing Academics and Wellness” with Jamal Robinson, Mei Lin, and Elena Petrova
2:00 PM–3:30 PM: Workshop: Nutrition and Fitness Tips for Busy Student Life
Register now:
http://www.universitywellness.org
All sessions held in the Butler Wellness Center.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the schedule?

options.A: To provide information on a conference keynote address
options.C: To list events happening at a conference
options.D: To provide information about refreshments at a conference

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the schedule? 原文依据： 全文为 UNIVERSITY HEALTH AND WELLNESS CONFERENCE 的 Schedule Highlights，按时间列出当天所有活动环节。 翻译： 全文是大学健康与保健会议的日程重点，按时间顺序列出了当天举办的各项活动。 选项分析： (A) To provide information on a conference keynote address 提供会议主题演讲信息 → 错误（只是一部分，不是主要目的） (B) To provide conference registration details 提供会议注册详情 → 错误（注册只是一小点） (C) To list events happening at a conference 列出会议上举办的活动 → 正确 (D) To provide information about refreshments at a conference 提供会议茶点信息 → 错误（只是很小一部分）

questions.stem: All of the following are reasons why someone might choose to attend the event EXCEPT

options.A: to learn how to concentrate better on their studies
options.B: to gather materials for applying to medical school
options.C: to speak directly with people in the health industry
options.D: to gain access to wellness resources

questions.analysis: All of the following are reasons why someone might choose to attend the event EXCEPT 原文依据： Learn practical tips… increasing your mental focus for more effective studying. Chat with wellness professionals who specialize in student health. Access free resources to support your mental and physical well-being. 翻译： 学习提高精力、提升专注力以便更高效学习的实用技巧。与专门研究学生健康的保健专业人士交流。获取免费资源支持身心健康。 选项分析： (A) to learn how to concentrate better on their studies 学习更好地专注学习 → 原文提及，正确 (B) to gather materials for applying to medical school 收集申请医学院的材料 → 原文未提及，是例外选项 (C) to speak directly with people in the health industry 直接和健康行业人士交流 → 原文提及，正确 (D) to gain access to wellness resources 获得保健资源 → 原文提及，正确

questions.stem: What is likely true about most of the attendees?

options.A: They will receive free healthcare services at the event.
options.B: They work in the health industry.
options.C: They are visiting from other regions.

questions.analysis: What is likely true about most of the attendees? 原文依据： increasing your mental focus for more effective studying Chat with wellness professionals who specialize in student health Meet speakers and fellow students 翻译： 提升学习专注力 与专门针对学生健康的专家交流 与演讲者和同学们见面 选项分析： (A) They will receive free healthcare services at the event. 他们会在活动中得到免费医疗服务 → 错误（只说免费资源，不是医疗服务） (B) They work in the health industry. 他们在健康行业工作 → 错误（嘉宾是，参与者主要是学生） (C) They are visiting from other regions. 他们从其他地区来 → 错误（原文无依据） (D) They are students. 他们是学生 → 正确
